name: AR-600 / AR-601
summary: Russia's first full-size anthropomorphic robot line, built by NPO Android Technics from 2006. The AR-600 (2008) and later AR-601 walk, speak and manipulate objects with two gripping manipulators; the programme fed directly into the tele-operated FEDOR robot that flew to the ISS in 2019.
notable: Technology base for the FEDOR / Skybot F-850 space robot
